economic_claim_policy.evidence_level: T4 discovery/context only; no new T2 or T3 evidence
economic_claim_policy.qualification: Research across ecosystems is not a proposed allocation or authorization to trade.

mechanisms.name: Collateralized borrowing as temporary cross-chain inventory replacement
mechanisms.spread_cause: An ordinary cross-chain price discrepancy may close before a bridge transfer arrives; locally borrowable inventory can shorten the exposed execution interval.
mechanisms.economic_payer: Other voluntary market participants trading across temporarily segmented liquidity; no guaranteed protocol subsidy.
mechanisms.potential_recurrence: Independent venue order flow and non-instant inventory replenishment may recur, but competition can fully absorb the residual.

asset_claim_equivalence.required: Borrowed liability must be repaid in exactly the reserve token owed; bridged receipt must be the same accepted token or have a documented executable conversion.
asset_claim_equivalence.historical_example: Seed Appendix G describes WETH/WBTC on Ethereum and WBTC borrowing/trading on Arbitrum.
asset_claim_equivalence.not_assumed: WBTC, tBTC, cbBTC and native BTC are not interchangeable delivery claims.

chain_protocol_contract_evidence.protocol: Aave, as named by historical paper

mechanisms.financing_inventory_repayment_lifecycle: Supply sufficient collateral on the borrowing chain, or obtain credit delegated by an adequately collateralized supplier; use temporary local inventory while an independent bridge transfer settles; repay the precise debt plus accrued interest from received inventory; only then release collateral. No global atomic rollback.
capital_access_assumptions: Collateral, haircut/liquidation buffer, inventory for the other leg, gas and failure reserve count against total capital.
Borrow cap, utilization, eMode, health-factor and reserve token restrictions must permit the desired liability.
Credit delegation requires a willing delegator and enforceable terms; borrower-level uncollateralized access is not collateral-free financing.
risks: One leg fills while the other fails
cheap_falsifiers: Exact destination reserve cannot be borrowed or bridged proceeds cannot repay that token.
Collateral and required inventory exhaust the capital constraint before a meaningful trade size.
A synchronized firm-quote edge is no larger than full costs under an honest delay/failure treatment.
mechanisms.next_read_only_check_if_separately_autho: Verify one named reserve's present token identity, borrow-enabled/cap state and public executable quote availability; reject before any price-series build if unavailable.

mechanisms.name: tBTC-native BTC conversion basis with stake-dependent fee segmentation
mechanisms.spread_cause: Native BTC redemption is asynchronous and fee-bearing; eligible T stakers may have different conversion cost floors from unstaked traders.
mechanisms.economic_payer: An ordinary secondary-market counterparty may pay for faster/differently located inventory. The waiver reduces an eligible protocol fee; it is not guaranteed cash income or a separate protocol reward.
mechanisms.potential_recurrence: Recurring BTC inventory demand and rolling waiver capacity could preserve heterogeneous costs. Competition or low turnover can eliminate any gain.

asset_claim_equivalence.required: Identify the exact tBTC representation and authorized gateway back to the Ethereum redemption claim, then account for native BTC amount, treasury fee, Bitcoin fee and time.
asset_claim_equivalence.not_assumed: Solana/Sui tBTC, native BTC, WBTC and strkBTC do not have automatically identical delivery, issuer, privacy or recovery rights.

mechanisms.financing_inventory_repayment_lifecycle: If eligible, lock T to obtain finite rolling fee-offset capacity; acquire the exact tBTC claim, satisfy the documented redemption path and wait for BTC settlement; replenish inventory only after settlement. Any BTC/tBTC/T hedge or loan has its own collateral, funding and repayment requirement. Timeout returns the documented token claim, not assured native BTC at a fixed time.
capital_access_assumptions: Current rendered product article documents 100000 T offsetting up to 0.001 tBTC eligible fees per rolling 30 days and a 30-day unstaking period; current contract settings unverified.
T principal, T market exposure, BTC/tBTC inventory, collateral, gas and locked funds all count toward capital.
Waiver eligibility, remaining capacity, dust thresholds, wallet capacity, gateway access and real BTC settlement latency must be verified.
cheap_falsifiers: Waiver capacity is too small relative to required T capital and turnover to overcome capital/hedge costs.
Claim cannot be redeemed by the relevant participant or cross-chain route is not live.
Full BTC settlement costs and conservative delay erase the measured secondary-market discount.
mechanisms.next_read_only_check_if_separately_autho: Reconcile current waiver eligibility/capacity and actual claim-to-BTC settlement path before collecting a price history.

mechanisms.name: Inventory service around naturally rate-limited NTT routes
mechanisms.spread_cause: Naturally exhausted directional bridge capacity can temporarily segment otherwise related token inventories.
mechanisms.economic_payer: A voluntary user or secondary-market counterparty wanting immediate inventory, if a real service premium exists; documentation does not establish a capacity-reset bounty.
mechanisms.potential_recurrence: Persistent one-way flow may produce repeated imbalances. Reverse natural flow replenishes capacity and may remove the premium.

asset_claim_equivalence.required: Exact configured NTT token pair, custody/mint authority, supported direction and delivery right.
asset_claim_equivalence.not_assumed: Same ticker or protocol name does not establish equal redemption rights; outbound and inbound queues are separate.

chain_protocol_contract_evidence.qualification: Read source includes a Sepolia configuration example; no production constrained route identified.

mechanisms.financing_inventory_repayment_lifecycle: Hold working inventory on both sides; serve genuine demand using existing accessible liquidity; replenish through normal permitted transfers as capacity becomes available. Any borrowing remains collateralized until actual settlement. Reverse-flow capacity replenishment is accounting, not a trader refund or source-chain cancellation guarantee.
capital_access_assumptions: Two-sided inventory and buffers count toward capital
Rate-window, cap and queue policy are deployment-specific
No induced congestion, drain, manipulation or attack
risks: Queue lasts longer than financing horizon
cheap_falsifiers: No genuinely constrained live route with third-party demand exists.
Observed premium never exceeds carry/rebalance/full execution costs.
Captured value is merely uncompensated bridge/issuer risk rather than a repeatable service margin.
mechanisms.next_read_only_check_if_separately_autho: Identify one documented mainnet token route and publicly observable naturally constrained transfer/quote before any simulation.

mechanisms.name: Exact-representation conversion and asymmetric route-cost basis
mechanisms.spread_cause: Bridged versus natively issued representations, route-specific fees and asynchronous settlement can create different inventory costs even when assets reference the same currency.
mechanisms.economic_payer: A voluntary trader needing a particular representation/location; no guaranteed fee rebate or issuer redemption access.
mechanisms.potential_recurrence: Payment flow and chain-specific demand may recur, but routing competition can remove any residual.

asset_claim_equivalence.required: Separate Tempo USDC.e backed through Stargate from native USDC and other native issuance, and standard OFT issuer claims from Stargate pools.
asset_claim_equivalence.normalization: Use documented unit/share conversion, paired channels, shared decimals and dust. Vanilla OFT does not automatically reconcile fee-on-transfer or rebasing assets.
asset_claim_equivalence.not_assumed: OUSD, USDC.e, USDT0 and yield-bearing stablecoin receipts are not identical assets.

chain_protocol_contract_evidence.qualification: A Stargate token pool address is not its message-security OApp. No live peer/DVN configuration was read.

mechanisms.financing_inventory_repayment_lifecycle: Use a documented representation-conversion path; finance both non-atomic legs and required fee inventory until destination credit/any composed action completes; only release financing after final accepted claim or liability repayment. Tempo outbound messaging uses the LZEndpointDollar fee wrapper, not native msg.value.
capital_access_assumptions: 0 bps is the documented Stargate transfer fee only for Ethereum-Tempo; other routes are quote-dependent
Gas, messaging, fee-wrapper inventory and finality are not free
Borrowability, issuer eligibility and channel configuration remain unknown
cheap_falsifiers: Representation has no available conversion to the asset required for closing the other leg.
Zero transfer fee is overwhelmed by messaging, gas, borrow and rebalance costs.
The apparent edge disappears after share/decimal normalization or exact route quoting.
mechanisms.next_read_only_check_if_separately_autho: Verify exact issuer/route rights and matched executable quote availability, not ticker-level historical prices.

mechanisms.name: New borrowing-market and collateral-claim segmentation
mechanisms.spread_cause: New hub/spoke collateral admission may alter financing costs for a particular issuer claim, without making that claim deliverable against another issuer or a stock perpetual.
mechanisms.economic_payer: Potentially voluntary financing/liquidity demand; no payer or realizable spread identified.
mechanisms.potential_recurrence: Different eligibility, collateral haircuts and borrower demand could persist; may simply price issuer, liquidation and access risks.

asset_claim_equivalence.required: Exact legal claim, token contract, share entitlement, permitted redemption, quote currency and collateral treatment.
asset_claim_equivalence.not_assumed: AAPLc is not automatically AAPLx, a Robinhood token, an exchange share or a cash-settled perpetual.

chain_protocol_contract_evidence.qualification: Changelog is deployment documentation, not proof every listed collateral can be borrowed or transferred permissionlessly.

mechanisms.financing_inventory_repayment_lifecycle: Would require permitted collateral delivery, a borrowable matched liability, hedge or redemption with actual access, financing until settlement, and repayment before collateral release. That complete lifecycle was not identified.
capital_access_assumptions: Issuer/access terms unknown
Caps/oracles/liquidation and concentration unknown
New instrument/version age must be evaluated separately from mature protocol brand
No allocation or leverage amount proposed
cheap_falsifiers: Listed asset is collateral-only or inaccessible
No matched redeemable/shortable claim exists
Funding benefit is fully offset by conversion, hedge and collateral costs
mechanisms.next_read_only_check_if_separately_autho: Verify one actual issuer claim and its borrowing/redemption rights before collecting prices.

mechanisms.name: Tokenized-stock cross-issuer, chain and perpetual basis
mechanisms.documentary_result: Official Robinhood mainnet, transferable debt-token structure and Apple registry row identified; xStocks tracker-certificate rights, eligible redemption and corporate-action accounting read; HIP-3 equity-market existence documented. A matched accessible closing pair is still unverified.
mechanisms.spread_cause: Different access, trading hours, settlement/redemption rights, corporate-action conventions, collateral and funding may segment instruments referring to the same stock.
mechanisms.economic_payer: If real, voluntary liquidity/financing demand on the richer leg; persistent issuer or cash-settlement risk premia need not converge.
mechanisms.potential_recurrence: Trading-hour and access segmentation can recur. This is not a locked arbitrage without an accessible documented conversion/hedge and a valid convergence mechanism.

asset_claim_equivalence.Robinhood_claim: RHJ tokenized debt security, no underlying legal/beneficial shareholder rights; primary subscription limited to authorized KYB participants, initially BBVI.
asset_claim_equivalence.xStocks_claim: Tracker certificate with economic exposure and segregated backing according to FAQ, not shareholder voting rights; eligible KYC retail redemption stated with $5000 minimum, subject to full issuer terms not read.
asset_claim_equivalence.corporate_action_normalization: Robinhood uiMultiplier changes shares per token with raw balance static. xStocks EVM balances rebase; Solana raw units stay static and Scaled UI applies. Dividend tax/reinvestment and underlying share units must be matched, not raw token balances.
asset_claim_equivalence.qualification: Neither issuer's claim is automatically deliverable against the other or against a cash-settled perpetual. Matched ticker/correlation does not establish convergence.

No such accessible complete pair/lifecycle was established.
capital_access_assumptions: User jurisdiction and institutional/retail eligibility not established; Robinhood explicitly excludes US persons and restricts other jurisdictions, while xStocks FAQ excludes US marketing/offers/solicitation
Robinhood primary subscription requires AP/KYB access; mint/burn documented Mon 02:00 to Sat 02:00 CET/CEST, not unrestricted 24/7 primary convertibility
xStocks FAQ describes eligible KYC retail direct redemption with $5000 minimum and normally 24/5 primary versus platform-dependent 24/7 secondary trading
Spot borrow/short availability, actual collateral assets, margin and cross-chain inventory all unknown; HIP-3 markets have independent deployer settings
No proposed notional or return
risks: Issuer claims diverge without delivery convergence
Jurisdiction blocks one leg or redemption
Only mock/testnet token exists for a proposed leg
cheap_falsifiers: A supposed live leg is mock/testnet-only or lacks a verified transferable contract and executable market.
No single legally eligible participant can access both legs and the closing/redemption path.
Underlying share class, currency, corporate-action units or derivative index cannot be matched.
There is no deliverable conversion or otherwise defensible convergence mechanism; basis is then unbounded exposure, not locked arbitrage.
Full financing, funding, corporate-action and settlement costs erase a synchronized executable spread.
